scope: Cloud software controls and synthetic statistical evidence only

required_jobs.name: Fresh runner restore and scientific exports

experiment_acceptance.scope: Execution, aggregation, inferential calculations and traceability only; upstream approvals are synthetic.

validated_boundaries: All named baselines, ablations, negative controls and robustness comparisons cover preregistered seeds.
A failed, changed or indirect pilot dependency prevents downstream execution.
Repeated rows and random seeds do not inflate independent-unit sample counts.
Frozen G3 approvals bind statistical protocols; refreezing changed thresholds cannot reuse old approval.
Registry/output hashes and matching executor receipts bind measured effects and claim mappings.
Negative and inconclusive comparisons remain visible; unsupported positive claims and selective comparison omission are rejected.
remaining: Real study validity, data rights, sample independence, method suitability, baseline fairness, causal identification, novelty and doctoral/Q1 merit still require scientific evidence and human G3/G4 review. Custom statistical models are source-bound but not recomputed by this component. Actual my-phd state and budget authority were not changed. CI artifacts expire after 14 days; this receipt preserves hashes and run identity, not all fixture bytes.
